automated.make strict: stopsVm VM == interpreter byte for byte
automated.make test: executor log ends exit 0 (not rerun); make sim package test was still running when the report was written

findings.issue: The old check 'a click on A's centre picks A, not the nearer B beside it' (at_point) was deleted in the rewrite of the alpha Cen A block. Now that the stop is 0.059 AU from A with B in view, that is the regression most likely to bite.
findings.suggestion: Restore it at the new stop.

findings.issue: Renders show relative size (TRAPPIST-1 a spark, alpha Cen A ~11 deg disc, Aldebaran huge, Jupiter 84 deg) but Earth, Saturn, Aldebaran are flat blown-out white discs with no limb or surface; 5_earth shows no recognisable Earth. Jupiter sky shows a hard diagonal terminator/ring-sheet seam. The visual check cannot confirm the body is Earth.
findings.suggestion: Exposure-compensate or lower brightness for the capture, or add a body-labelled crop, and explain/fix the Jupiter diagonal seam.

findings.issue: defaultStopKm now applies the D-54 star curve to the Sun, alpha Cen and destination stars for every body plan with stop_rule 0 too (previously 10 R / ring rule); only the maxS 10 AU cap limits it. Tour star stops stay on D-47 only because they pass explicit standoffs. Behaviour change for any caller using the default is untested outside Sun 5 deg.
findings.suggestion: Add a test that a stop_rule-0 default star body plan is what is documented, or note it in the design doc.

findings.issue: The startInside exemption is narrow (only planFiniteStop; per-body test that the ship is within R+bubble of that body at t0), which is acceptable. But it exempts any body the ship is inside, not just the Sun at the sol origin, and has no negative test that planFiniteStop still refuses a start inside, say, Earth for a non-Sol plan.
findings.suggestion: Scope it to the sun id or add the negative test.

findings.issue: stopRule is a float compared with == 54.0 and is not echoed in params (decodeFullParams resets it to 0.0), so a replay from a params echo silently loses the rule; matches standoffAu precedent but weakens determinism of recorded sessions.
findings.suggestion: Confirm replays carry the stop_rule override, or echo it.

findings.issue: Sound (zero elapsed time replan, stale commit never sent, refusal reported), but _last_plan is a single remembered intent: if the user plans an in-system body then Return to Sol, the check relies on the latest plan intent in the same tick. No test covers the refused-replan branch.
findings.suggestion: Add a test for the refusal branch.

findings.issue: Doc status is Planned/Implemented-on-branch; D-54 part 2 (inferred radii labelled 'inferred') and the synchronous-orbit I-card line are not done. The stop was correct under CLAUDE.md gate 3: a bolometric-correction table and luminosity-to-radius are astrophysics maths that belong in sunholo/relativity first, and the blackbody shortcut was measured (Proxima 0.05 vs 0.154 R_sun) and rejected, a good call. It was reported clearly in the doc (open questions with proposed exports) and CHANGELOG. By contrast the D-54 stop rule (tan/atan/sqrt/sin geometry, std/math only) is a design placement rule, not physics, so it is legitimately in sim/stops.ail. Ledger D-54 should stay open (or be split) until the package release lands; the doc does not say the row is only partially satisfied outside its Status line.

recommendations: Fix capture exposure so Earth/Saturn/Aldebaran show structure, explain the Jupiter seam
Add negative test for the startInside exemption and scope it to the sol origin
File the package request (bolometric correction, luminosity, radius, synchronous orbit) as a ledger row/issue so part 2 is tracked
